caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular piece of woven textile oriented horizontally within a lightly outlined rectangular border. The textile features a sequence of vertical color bands on the left side, including narrow stripes of teal, red, blue, black, and gray. These bands are irregularly spaced, with most of the leftmost edge having alternating dark, cool, and warm hues. Toward the middle and right, the majority of the textile is dominated by a wide, solid band of black weaving, which extends nearly to the right edge. The far right of the textile is bordered by a slightly narrower red band. The edges of the textile, especially on the left, appear frayed and uneven, indicating the loose ends of the woven fabric. The color application is uniform, with each colored band having clear boundaries, and the whole textile rests against a plain, light background. There are small, faint hand-written markings and numbers under the textile and along the lower border of the drawing.
title: Woolen Cloth
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
